blocks.zh: 📚 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: 📚 Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 區分 工程變更管理（ECM）與品質變更管制（QCC）的適用時機與核心差異，並能對應到C&Q專案生命週期的各階段。
blocks.en: Distinguish the applicability and core differences between Engineering Change Management (ECM) and Quality Change Control (QCC), and map them to each stage of the C&Q project lifecycle.

blocks.zh: 理解 ECM 在設計、建造、C&Q 及運營各階段的具體應用方式，以及何時需要品質單位（QA）參與審核。
blocks.en: Understand how ECM is applied in the design, construction, C&Q and operational phases, and when review by the quality unit (QA) is required.

blocks.zh: 掌握 良好文件管理規範（GDocP）的核心要素，包含 ALCOA 原則及其在C&Q文件中的實際要求。
blocks.en: Master the core elements of Good Documentation Practice (GDocP), including the ALCOA principles and their practical requirements for C&Q documents.

blocks.zh: 正確執行文件更正程序：單線劃除、日期簽名，嚴禁塗改液或覆蓋原始數據。
blocks.en: Carry out the document correction procedure correctly: single-line strike-through, date and signature; correction fluid or overwriting of original data is strictly prohibited.

blocks.zh: 了解 FDA/EMA 查廠常見的 GDocP 缺失，以及 CDMO 如何建立合規的文件管理文化。
blocks.en: Learn the GDocP deficiencies most commonly found in FDA/EMA inspections, and how a CDMO can build a compliant documentation culture.

blocks.zh: Chapter 12: Change Management — 變更管理
blocks.en: Chapter 12: Change Management

blocks.zh: 12.1 Introduction — 導論 | Pages 89–90
blocks.en: 12.1 Introduction | Pages 89–90

blocks.zh: 💬 中文解說 Commentary
blocks.en: 💬 Commentary

blocks.zh: 🔧 核心概念：兩種變更管理模式
blocks.en: 🔧 Core Concept: Two Change Management Models

blocks.zh: ISPE Vol.5 將變更管理分為兩種截然不同的機制，對應C&Q生命週期的不同階段：
blocks.en: ISPE Vol.5 divides change management into two distinct mechanisms, corresponding to different stages of the C&Q lifecycle:

blocks.zh: ECM（工程變更管理）：適用於系統尚未被QA接受與放行之前，由工程或運營單位主導，重點在於控制設計與施工過程中的技術變更。
blocks.en: ECM (Engineering Change Management): applies before the system has been accepted and released by QA. It is led by Engineering or Operations and focuses on controlling technical changes during design and construction.

blocks.zh: QCC（品質變更管制）：適用於系統已完成資格確認並正式投入生產之後，由QA主導，任何變更均需事前取得QA預先核准。
blocks.en: QCC (Quality Change Control): applies after the system has been qualified and put into production. It is led by QA, and any change requires QA's prior approval before implementation.

blocks.zh: 🏗 生活比喻：蓋房子 vs. 住房子之後
blocks.en: 🏗 Everyday Analogy: Building a House vs. Living in It

blocks.zh: 想像蓋一棟房子：
blocks.en: Imagine building a house:

blocks.zh: 施工階段（ECM）：牆壁位置、管線走向可以由工程師決定修改，只要記錄在施工圖並通知相關人員即可。
blocks.en: Construction stage (ECM): engineers can decide to change wall positions or pipe routing, as long as the change is recorded on the construction drawings and the relevant people are notified.

blocks.zh: 入住後（QCC）：要拆牆或改電線，必須先向管理委員會（=QA）提出申請，獲准後才能動工，完工後還要驗收。
blocks.en: After move-in (QCC): to knock down a wall or change the wiring, you must first apply to the homeowners' association (= QA), and work can begin only after approval; an inspection is also required once the work is finished.

blocks.zh: C&Q 中的「入住」時刻就是 QA 接受與放行（Acceptance and Release）。
blocks.en: The "move-in" moment in C&Q is QA Acceptance and Release.

blocks.zh: ⚠ 實務要點：Like-for-Like 的判定
blocks.en: ⚠ Practical Point: Determining Like-for-Like

blocks.zh: 同類替換（like-for-like）可能不構成「變更」，但這不是免費通行證。組織必須建立明確的評估程序，包含：
blocks.en: Like-for-like replacement may not constitute a "change", but this is not a free pass. The organization must establish a clear assessment procedure that covers:

blocks.zh: 零件型號、規格、製造商是否完全相同
blocks.en: Whether the part number, specification and manufacturer are exactly the same

blocks.zh: 性能特性（如流量、壓力）是否無任何差異
blocks.en: Whether performance characteristics (e.g., flow, pressure) show no difference at all

blocks.zh: 若有任何不同，即使微小，也應視為變更啟動評估
blocks.en: If anything differs, however small, treat it as a change and start an assessment

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠常見缺失之一：企業聲稱 like-for-like，但缺乏書面評估記錄。
blocks.en: One common FDA inspection deficiency: a company claims like-for-like but has no written assessment record.

blocks.zh: 🏭 CDMO 實務應用
blocks.en: 🏭 CDMO Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，ECM 與 QCC 的界線格外重要：
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, the boundary between ECM and QCC is especially important:

blocks.zh: 新廠設施建造期間：使用 ECM，由工程部門主導，CDE 相關變更須通知QA
blocks.en: During construction of a new facility: use ECM, led by Engineering; changes related to CDEs must be notified to QA

blocks.zh: PQ 執行前後：即使系統還在試運行，一旦QA已正式放行，任何設計修改就必須走 QCC
blocks.en: Before and after PQ execution: even if the system is still in trial operation, once QA has formally released it, any design modification must go through QCC

blocks.zh: 客戶導入新產品期間：若需修改現有已確認設備的參數或硬體，均屬 QCC 範疇
blocks.en: During introduction of a new customer product: any modification to the parameters or hardware of existing qualified equipment falls under QCC

blocks.zh: 12.2 Engineering Change Management (ECM) — 工程變更管理
blocks.en: 12.2 Engineering Change Management (ECM)

blocks.zh: 🧩 名詞解釋：ECM 的三大應用領域
blocks.en: 🧩 Terminology: The Three Application Areas of ECM

blocks.zh: ECM 並非只存在於建造期間，它在三個情境下均發揮作用：
blocks.en: ECM does not exist only during construction; it applies in three situations:

blocks.zh: GMP 與非GMP系統運營期間的生命週期管理：廠房設備的長期維護更改
blocks.en: Lifecycle management during operation of GMP and non-GMP systems: long-term maintenance changes to facilities and equipment

blocks.zh: C&Q 專案期間的主要變更機制：從 DR/DQ 到 FAT/SAT 都適用
blocks.en: The main change mechanism during C&Q projects: applicable from DR/DQ through FAT/SAT

blocks.zh: 已確認系統非關鍵面向的技術變更：例如更換非 CDE 的零件
blocks.en: Technical changes to non-critical aspects of qualified systems: for example, replacing a non-CDE component

blocks.zh: 📊 風險相稱原則
blocks.en: 📊 The Risk-Proportionate Principle

blocks.zh: 「文件程度應與變更風險相稱」是 ISPE 的一貫哲學。
blocks.en: "Documentation should be proportionate to the risk of the change" is a consistent ISPE philosophy.

blocks.zh: 低風險變更（非GMP管道）：簡單的工程記錄即可
blocks.en: Low-risk changes (non-GMP pathway): a simple engineering record is sufficient

blocks.zh: 中風險變更（GMP但非CDE）：需完整ECM記錄，通知相關SME
blocks.en: Medium-risk changes (GMP but not CDE): a complete ECM record is required, with notification of the relevant SMEs

blocks.zh: 高風險變更（涉及CDE/CA）：ECM + QA核准，或直接走QCC
blocks.en: High-risk changes (involving CDE/CA): ECM + QA approval, or go directly through QCC

blocks.zh: 這與 ICH Q9 的風險管理原則一致——不應對所有變更一律採用最繁瑣的程序。
blocks.en: This is consistent with the risk management principles of ICH Q9: the most burdensome procedure should not be applied to every change.

blocks.zh: ⚠ 常見混淆：ECM + QA核准 vs. QCC
blocks.en: ⚠ Common Confusion: ECM + QA Approval vs. QCC

blocks.zh: 許多實務人員容易混淆這兩種模式：
blocks.en: Many practitioners confuse these two models:

blocks.zh: ECM + QA核准：適用於 放行前，QA 在工程框架內核准變更，不需要「預先批准」的正式變更單
blocks.en: ECM + QA approval: applies before release; QA approves the change within the engineering framework, and a formal change request with "prior approval" is not required

blocks.zh: QCC：適用於 放行後，正式品質管理系統（PQS）內的變更控制，必須在實施前取得QA預先批准
blocks.en: QCC: applies after release; change control within the formal pharmaceutical quality system (PQS), where QA prior approval must be obtained before implementation

blocks.zh: 核心區別在於：時間點（放行前/後）和誰主導（工程/QA）。
blocks.en: The key differences are timing (before/after release) and who leads (Engineering/QA).

blocks.zh: 🏭 CDMO 決策樹：ECM vs. QCC
blocks.en: 🏭 CDMO Decision Tree: ECM vs. QCC

blocks.zh: 遇到變更請求時，CDMO 工程師可依此判斷：
blocks.en: When a change request arises, a CDMO engineer can decide as follows:

blocks.zh: 系統已被QA正式放行了嗎？→ 是 → 走 QCC
blocks.en: Has the system been formally released by QA? → Yes → go through QCC

blocks.zh: 變更影響到 CA 或 CDE 嗎？→ 是 → 需QA核准（ECM或QCC視放行狀態而定）
blocks.en: Does the change affect a CA or CDE? → Yes → QA approval is required (ECM or QCC, depending on release status)

blocks.zh: 變更只涉及非關鍵面向，且有System Risk Assessment支持嗎？→ 是 → ECM 即可，不需QA
blocks.en: Does the change involve only non-critical aspects and is it supported by a System Risk Assessment? → Yes → ECM is sufficient, no QA needed

blocks.zh: 以上皆否 → 與QA共同評估
blocks.en: None of the above → assess jointly with QA

blocks.zh: 12.3 Change Management during C&Q Projects — C&Q 期間的變更管理
blocks.en: 12.3 Change Management during C&Q Projects

blocks.zh: 🚦 重要原則：放行前不需QA預先核准
blocks.en: 🚦 Key Principle: No QA Prior Approval Needed Before Release

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出：在系統尚未用於商業或臨床生產之前，設計或功能的改變 不會對病患造成直接風險，因此法規上並不要求 QA 在變更實施前預先核准。
blocks.en: ISPE states clearly: before a system is used for commercial or clinical production, changes to design or functionality pose no direct risk to patients, so regulations do not require QA to approve changes in advance of implementation.

blocks.zh: 這個原則打破了許多人的直覺。但這不代表可以隨意更改——ECM 仍然要求記錄所有變更，且涉及 CDE 的變更必須在驗證測試前取得 QA 核准。
blocks.en: This principle goes against many people's intuition. It does not mean changes can be made freely: ECM still requires all changes to be recorded, and changes involving CDEs must be approved by QA before verification testing.

blocks.zh: ⚠ 數據完整性警示：修正後的重測義務
blocks.en: ⚠ Data Integrity Warning: The Obligation to Retest after Corrections

blocks.zh: C&Q 期間的修復工作（fix & repair）可能使已完成的測試數據失效。例如：
blocks.en: Fix and repair work during C&Q may invalidate test data that has already been completed. For example:

blocks.zh: 儀器校正偏差被修正後，之前的測量結果需重新評估
blocks.en: After an instrument calibration deviation is corrected, previous measurement results must be re-evaluated

blocks.zh: 管線重新焊接後，之前的壓力測試可能需重做
blocks.en: After a pipe is re-welded, earlier pressure tests may need to be repeated

blocks.zh: 軟體邏輯修改後，相關的 IQ/OQ 測試步驟需重新確認
blocks.en: After software logic is modified, the related IQ/OQ test steps must be reconfirmed

blocks.zh: 因此，ECM 記錄中必須包含「此次修正對現有測試數據的影響評估」，這是常被忽略的環節。
blocks.en: Therefore, the ECM record must include "an assessment of the impact of this correction on existing test data", a step that is often overlooked.

blocks.zh: 🔧 「As-Is 接受」的正確做法
blocks.en: 🔧 The Correct Way to "Accept As-Is"

blocks.zh: 當問題無法修正時（如設計限制），「接受現狀（accept as-is）」是允許的，但必須：
blocks.en: When a problem cannot be corrected (e.g., a design limitation), "accept as-is" is permitted, but it must be:

blocks.zh: 由有資格的 SME 評估可接受性
blocks.en: Assessed for acceptability by a qualified SME

blocks.zh: 在試車記錄中明確說明為何可接受
blocks.en: Clearly justified in the commissioning record

blocks.zh: 評估是否影響 CDE/CQA（若有，則需QA認可）
blocks.en: Evaluated for impact on CDE/CQA (if there is an impact, QA acknowledgment is required)

blocks.zh: 空白的接受理由或僅寫「OK」是不合規的記錄。
blocks.en: A blank acceptance rationale, or one that merely says "OK", is a non-compliant record.

blocks.zh: 12.4 Change Management during Operation — 運營期間的變更管理
blocks.en: 12.4 Change Management during Operation

blocks.zh: 🏭 運營期間的變更管理框架
blocks.en: 🏭 Change Management Framework during Operation

blocks.zh: 系統正式投入生產後，變更管理進入最嚴格的階段：
blocks.en: Once the system is formally in production, change management enters its strictest stage:

blocks.zh: 影響 CDE/CA 的變更：必須走 QCC，QA 必須在實施前預先核准
blocks.en: Changes affecting CDE/CA: must go through QCC, and QA must approve in advance of implementation

blocks.zh: 非關鍵面向的變更：可繼續使用 ECM，但需有 System Risk Assessment 支持
blocks.en: Changes to non-critical aspects: may continue to use ECM, but must be supported by a System Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 緊急情況：GMP 通常允許緊急實施，但事後必須補正式核准程序
blocks.en: Emergencies: GMP generally allows emergency implementation, but the formal approval process must be completed afterwards

blocks.zh: ⚠ 法規要求：21 CFR 211.100 & EU GMP §5.23
blocks.en: ⚠ Regulatory Requirements: 21 CFR 211.100 & EU GMP §5.23

blocks.zh: 美國 FDA（21 CFR 211.100）和歐盟 GMP（Volume 4, §5.23）均明確要求：
blocks.en: Both the US FDA (21 CFR 211.100) and EU GMP (Volume 4, §5.23) explicitly require that:

blocks.zh: 書面程序（SOP）必須由有資格人員審核和核准
blocks.en: Written procedures (SOPs) must be reviewed and approved by qualified personnel

blocks.zh: 任何偏離已核准程序的行為必須調查
blocks.en: Any deviation from approved procedures must be investigated

blocks.zh: 變更控制必須評估對已確認狀態的影響
blocks.en: Change control must assess the impact on the qualified state

blocks.zh: 這是為何 QCC 在放行後成為強制要求的法規基礎。
blocks.en: This is the regulatory basis for QCC becoming mandatory after release.

blocks.zh: 💻 變更追蹤系統的要求
blocks.en: 💻 Requirements for Change Tracking Systems

blocks.zh: QCC 要求維護完整的變更歷史，現代製藥企業通常使用以下工具：
blocks.en: QCC requires a complete change history to be maintained. Modern pharmaceutical companies typically use tools such as:

blocks.zh: 電子化變更控制系統（如 Veeva Vault QualityDocs、MasterControl）
blocks.en: Electronic change control systems (e.g., Veeva Vault QualityDocs, MasterControl)

blocks.zh: 系統應能提供隨時調閱（on demand）的完整變更記錄
blocks.en: The system should be able to provide a complete change record on demand

blocks.zh: 稽核追蹤（audit trail）功能確保每筆變更均有時間戳記和核准人員記錄
blocks.en: The audit trail function ensures that every change has a timestamp and a record of the approver

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠時，審查員可能要求即時調閱特定設備的完整變更歷史，因此系統的查詢功能至關重要。
blocks.en: During an FDA inspection, the inspector may ask for the complete change history of specific equipment on the spot, so the system's search capability is critical.

blocks.zh: 12.5 Engineering Change Management Process — ECM 流程詳述
blocks.en: 12.5 Engineering Change Management Process

blocks.zh: 📋 ECM 表單的必要元素
blocks.en: 📋 Required Elements of an ECM Form

blocks.zh: 一份完整的 ECM 變更申請記錄應包含以下內容，這也是稽核員查閱時的核查清單：
blocks.en: A complete ECM change request record should contain the following, which is also the checklist an auditor will use:

blocks.zh: 發起人姓名與日期（可歸責性 Attributability）
blocks.en: Initiator's name and date (Attributability)

blocks.zh: 變更描述：影響的系統、區域、目的
blocks.en: Description of change: affected systems, areas, purpose

blocks.zh: 多維度影響評估：品質、進度、預算、其他系統、文件
blocks.en: Multi-dimensional impact assessment: quality, schedule, budget, other systems, documentation

blocks.zh: 利益相關者通知記錄
blocks.en: Record of stakeholder notification

blocks.zh: 核准/拒絕記錄
blocks.en: Approval/rejection record

blocks.zh: 完成追蹤：確認已按核准內容實施
blocks.en: Completion follow-up: confirmation that the change was implemented as approved

blocks.zh: ⚠ 偏差優先處理順序：設計 > 安裝 > 程序
blocks.en: ⚠ Order of Priority for Deviation Correction: Design > Installation > Procedure

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確規定偏差改正的優先順序：
blocks.en: ISPE clearly specifies the order of priority for correcting deviations:

blocks.zh: 設計變更（最優先）：從根本解決問題，修改設計或規格
blocks.en: Design change (highest priority): resolves the problem at its root by modifying the design or specification

blocks.zh: 安裝變更：修改物理安裝方式，如管線位置、設備位置
blocks.en: Installation change: modifies the physical installation, such as pipe or equipment location

blocks.zh: 操作程序變更（最後手段）：用 SOP 彌補設計/安裝的不足
blocks.en: Operating procedure change (last resort): uses an SOP to compensate for shortcomings in design/installation

blocks.zh: 這個優先順序反映了一個重要理念：依賴操作人員執行特殊程序來彌補硬體缺陷，比修改硬體本身風險更高。
blocks.en: This order of priority reflects an important principle: relying on operators to follow special procedures to compensate for hardware defects carries higher risk than modifying the hardware itself.

blocks.zh: 🏭 CDMO 施工期間的 ECM 實例
blocks.en: 🏭 Examples of ECM during CDMO Construction

blocks.zh: 典型的CDMO建廠 ECM 情境：
blocks.en: Typical ECM scenarios in CDMO facility construction:

blocks.zh: 管線路徑調整（非CDE）→ ECM，工程師核准，更新P&ID
blocks.en: Pipe route adjustment (non-CDE) → ECM, engineer approval, update P&ID

blocks.zh: WFI 分配管線設計壓力修改（可能涉及CDE）→ ECM + QA核准，更新URS
blocks.en: Change to the design pressure of the WFI distribution piping (possibly involving CDE) → ECM + QA approval, update URS

blocks.zh: 無菌灌裝機 HEPA 過濾器規格由H13改H14（CDE）→ ECM + QA核准，評估對OQ的影響
blocks.en: Change of the HEPA filter specification on the aseptic filling machine from H13 to H14 (CDE) → ECM + QA approval, assess impact on OQ

blocks.zh: 天花板石膏板牆面更換材質（非GMP）→ ECM，無需通知QA
blocks.en: Change of material for the ceiling gypsum board wall surface (non-GMP) → ECM, no need to notify QA

blocks.zh: Chapter 13: Good Documentation Practice for C&Q — C&Q 良好文件管理規範
blocks.en: Chapter 13: Good Documentation Practice for C&Q

blocks.zh: 📑 ALCOA 原則詳解 — 數據完整性的基石
blocks.en: 📑 The ALCOA Principles Explained: The Cornerstone of Data Integrity

blocks.zh: ALCOA 是全球製藥法規（FDA、EMA、WHO）要求的數據完整性核心框架：
blocks.en: ALCOA is the core data integrity framework required by pharmaceutical regulators worldwide (FDA, EMA, WHO):

blocks.zh: A – Attributable（可歸責）：清楚記錄誰在何時執行了什麼操作。每筆記錄都必須有識別資訊（簽名/姓名縮寫 + 日期）。
blocks.en: A – Attributable: clearly record who performed what action and when. Every record must carry identification (signature/initials + date).

blocks.zh: L – Legible（清晰易讀）：記錄必須永久且清晰可讀。潦草、褪色、被遮蓋的記錄均不合規。
blocks.en: L – Legible: records must be permanent and clearly readable. Illegible, faded or obscured records are non-compliant.

blocks.zh: C – Contemporaneous（當時記錄）：在操作執行的當下立即記錄，不允許事後補記（backdating）。
blocks.en: C – Contemporaneous: record immediately when the action is performed; backdating is not permitted.

blocks.zh: O – Original（原始資料）：保留第一手記錄；若需謄抄，原始資料必須保留並標註。
blocks.en: O – Original: retain the first-hand record; if transcription is needed, the original data must be retained and identified.

blocks.zh: A – Accurate（準確）：數據必須真實反映實際結果，不得捏造或篡改。
blocks.en: A – Accurate: data must truthfully reflect the actual results and must not be fabricated or falsified.

blocks.zh: ⚠ ALCOA+ 的延伸要求
blocks.en: ⚠ The Extended Requirements of ALCOA+

blocks.zh: 現代法規（特別是 FDA 2018年數據完整性指南）在 ALCOA 基礎上加入四個「+」：
blocks.en: Modern regulations (especially the FDA's 2018 data integrity guidance) add four "+" attributes to ALCOA:

blocks.zh: Complete（完整）：不得選擇性記錄；所有測試（包含不合格）都必須記錄
blocks.en: Complete: no selective recording; all tests (including failures) must be recorded

blocks.zh: Consistent（一致）：記錄方式應跨人員、跨時間保持一致
blocks.en: Consistent: the recording method should be consistent across personnel and over time

blocks.zh: Enduring（永久性）：記錄必須以不易損壞的方式保存（如不用鉛筆、可擦鋼筆）
blocks.en: Enduring: records must be kept in a durable form (e.g., no pencil, no erasable pens)

blocks.zh: Available（可取得）：稽核時可即時提供給主管機關審閱
blocks.en: Available: can be provided immediately for review by the authorities during an audit

blocks.zh: 🧪 GEP vs. GMP 文件的關鍵差異
blocks.en: 🧪 Key Differences between GEP and GMP Documents

blocks.zh: 一個容易理解的比較：
blocks.en: An easy way to understand the comparison:

blocks.zh: GEP（試車文件）：像工程師的工作筆記——可以反覆試驗，記錄最終結果；工程判斷足夠
blocks.en: GEP (commissioning documents): like an engineer's working notes; trials can be repeated and the final result recorded; engineering judgment is sufficient

blocks.zh: GMP（確認文件）：像法庭證據——必須按計畫執行，逐步記錄，任何偏差都要記錄和說明
blocks.en: GMP (qualification documents): like evidence in court; must be executed according to plan, recorded step by step, and any deviation must be recorded and explained

blocks.zh: 這個區別決定了試車報告能否被當作確認文件使用——必須達到 GMP 文件標準才行。
blocks.en: This difference determines whether a commissioning report can be used as a qualification document: it must meet GMP documentation standards.

blocks.zh: 🏭 廠商文件用於確認的風險
blocks.en: 🏭 Risks of Using Vendor Documents for Qualification

blocks.zh: 許多 CDMO 希望使用設備廠商的 FAT/SAT 文件替代自己的 IQ/OQ，ISPE 允許此做法，但前提是：
blocks.en: Many CDMOs want to use the equipment vendor's FAT/SAT documents in place of their own IQ/OQ. ISPE allows this, provided that:

blocks.zh: 廠商已通過評估（Vendor Qualification/Audit）
blocks.en: The vendor has been assessed (Vendor Qualification/Audit)

blocks.zh: 廠商的 QMS 達到可接受標準
blocks.en: The vendor's QMS meets acceptable standards

blocks.zh: 廠商文件已按 GDocP 要求執行
blocks.en: The vendor's documents were executed in accordance with GDocP requirements

blocks.zh: 使用理由已由 SME 和 QA 書面核准
blocks.en: The rationale for use has been approved in writing by the SME and QA

blocks.zh: 若廠商文件品質不足，引用它可能使整個確認包的可信度受損。
blocks.en: If the quality of the vendor documents is inadequate, relying on them may undermine the credibility of the entire qualification package.

blocks.zh: 13.2 C&Q Document Development Basics — 文件開發基礎
blocks.en: 13.2 C&Q Document Development Basics

blocks.zh: 📝 範本（Template）管理的最佳實踐
blocks.en: 📝 Best Practices for Template Management

blocks.zh: 使用已核准的標準範本執行測試，是提升效率的聰明做法。關鍵要求：
blocks.en: Using approved standard templates to execute tests is a smart way to improve efficiency. Key requirements:

blocks.zh: 範本核准一次，多次使用，無需每次重新核准
blocks.en: A template is approved once and used many times, with no need for re-approval each time

blocks.zh: 但必須確認使用時範本為最新版本（即文件管控有效）
blocks.en: However, it must be confirmed at the time of use that the template is the current version (i.e., document control is effective)

blocks.zh: SME 必須確認範本涵蓋該特定系統的所有必要測試——若不足，必須增補
blocks.en: The SME must confirm that the template covers all necessary tests for the specific system; if not, it must be supplemented

blocks.zh: 🔄 可重複性 vs. 可再現性
blocks.en: 🔄 Repeatability vs. Reproducibility

blocks.zh: 這兩個概念源自量測系統分析（MSA）：
blocks.en: These two concepts originate from Measurement System Analysis (MSA):

blocks.zh: Repeatability（可重複性）：同一人、同一設備、同一條件，重複執行得到相同結果。測試的「自身一致性」。
blocks.en: Repeatability: the same person, same equipment and same conditions, repeating the test, obtain the same results. The test's "self-consistency".

blocks.zh: Reproducibility（可再現性）：不同人、不同地點、不同設備，執行相同程序得到相同結果。測試的「跨人員一致性」。
blocks.en: Reproducibility: different people, locations and equipment, performing the same procedure, obtain the same results. The test's "consistency across personnel".

blocks.zh: 若測試程序寫得模糊，不同人執行可能得到不同結果，確認的可信度就會下降。
blocks.en: If a test procedure is written vaguely, different people may obtain different results, and the credibility of the qualification declines.

blocks.zh: ⚠ 語言選擇與法規審查
blocks.en: ⚠ Language Choice and Regulatory Review

blocks.zh: 執行文件可以用本地語言（如中文、日文）撰寫，但總結報告建議以英文撰寫，原因是：
blocks.en: Execution documents may be written in the local language (e.g., Chinese, Japanese), but summary reports are recommended to be written in English, because:

blocks.zh: FDA/EMA 查廠時審查員通常只能閱讀英文
blocks.en: During FDA/EMA inspections, inspectors can usually read only English

blocks.zh: 英文摘要讓跨國監管機構無需翻譯即可評估
blocks.en: An English summary lets multinational regulators assess the work without translation

blocks.zh: CDMO 為多國客戶服務時，英文摘要減少溝通障礙
blocks.en: When a CDMO serves customers in multiple countries, an English summary reduces communication barriers

blocks.zh: 13.3 Document Execution — 文件執行規範
blocks.en: 13.3 Document Execution

blocks.zh: 👥 執行者資格與簽名記錄
blocks.en: 👥 Executor Qualifications and Signature Records

blocks.zh: 執行者（Executor）必須具備相應的教育背景、培訓和經驗。關鍵要求：
blocks.en: Executors must have appropriate education, training and experience. Key requirements:

blocks.zh: 每位執行者必須在簽名記錄表（Signature Log）中登記：印刷全名、正式簽名、縮寫（Initials）
blocks.en: Every executor must be registered in the Signature Log with printed full name, formal signature and initials

blocks.zh: 自我審核原則：任何人不得審核或核准自己的工作——這是 GDocP 的基本原則，也是利益衝突的防範機制
blocks.en: Self-review principle: no one may review or approve their own work; this is a basic GDocP principle and a safeguard against conflicts of interest

blocks.zh: ⏰ 當時記錄原則 — FDA 最常引用的缺失
blocks.en: ⏰ The Contemporaneous Principle: The Deficiency FDA Cites Most Often

blocks.zh: 「事後補記」（backdating）是 FDA 483 觀察和 Warning Letter 中最常見的 GDocP 缺失之一。
blocks.en: Backdating is one of the most common GDocP deficiencies in FDA 483 observations and Warning Letters.

blocks.zh: 合規要求：測試步驟執行時立即記錄，不論是好是壞的結果。
blocks.en: Compliance requirement: record immediately when a test step is executed, whether the result is good or bad.

blocks.zh: 常見違規情境：
blocks.en: Common violation scenarios:

blocks.zh: 測試當天忘記記錄，隔天才填寫
blocks.en: Forgetting to record on the day of the test and filling it in the next day

blocks.zh: 先記錄在便利貼，之後再謄抄到正式文件
blocks.en: Recording on a sticky note first and transcribing it into the formal document later

blocks.zh: 批次記錄在一天結束時集中填寫，而非操作當下填寫
blocks.en: Filling in batch records all at once at the end of the day rather than at the time of the operation

blocks.zh: 電子記錄系統的稽核追蹤（Audit Trail）可以顯示記錄時間，使事後補記容易被發現。
blocks.en: The audit trail of an electronic record system can show when a record was made, making backdating easy to detect.

blocks.zh: 📄 謄抄數據（Transcribed Data）的要求
blocks.en: 📄 Requirements for Transcribed Data

blocks.zh: 當數據需要從原始記錄謄抄到另一份文件時：
blocks.en: When data must be transcribed from an original record to another document:

blocks.zh: 謄抄者必須簽名並標注日期
blocks.en: The transcriber must sign and date

blocks.zh: 包含原始數據的採集日期（不是謄抄日期）
blocks.en: Include the date the original data was collected (not the transcription date)

blocks.zh: 必須由第二人核查謄抄準確性
blocks.en: A second person must verify the accuracy of the transcription

blocks.zh: 原始數據必須保留，標記清楚並附上姓名縮寫和日期
blocks.en: The original data must be retained, clearly marked, with initials and date

blocks.zh: 🖨 熱感紙打印件的特殊處理
blocks.en: 🖨 Special Handling of Thermal Paper Printouts

blocks.zh: 粒子計數器、天平等儀器常使用熱感紙（thermal paper），熱感紙容易褪色，違反「Legible」和「Enduring」原則。
blocks.en: Instruments such as particle counters and balances often use thermal paper, which fades easily and violates the "Legible" and "Enduring" principles.

blocks.zh: 正確做法：立即複印（photocopy），複印件由執行人員簽名並標注「True Copy」和日期，原件注明存放位置。
blocks.en: Correct practice: photocopy immediately; the executor signs the copy, marks it "True Copy" and dates it, and the original notes its storage location.

blocks.zh: ✏ 13.3.2 書面記錄的核心要求匯總
blocks.en: ✏ 13.3.2 Summary of Core Requirements for Written Records

blocks.zh: 墨水要求：永久性、不褪色、不暈開；建議藍色或黑色；禁用鉛筆（除非立即複印存檔）
blocks.en: Ink requirements: permanent, non-fading, non-smearing; blue or black recommended; pencil prohibited (unless photocopied and filed immediately)

blocks.zh: 日期格式：DD-MMM-YYYY（如 30-MAY-2019）最佳，避免歧義（01/02/03 可能是1月2日或2月1日）
blocks.en: Date format: DD-MMM-YYYY (e.g., 30-MAY-2019) is best, to avoid ambiguity (01/02/03 could be 2 January or 1 February)

blocks.zh: 數量結果禁止寫：Pass / Fail / OK / Yes / ✓ — 必須記錄實際測量數值
blocks.en: For quantitative results, do not write: Pass / Fail / OK / Yes / ✓; the actual measured value must be recorded

blocks.zh: 空白格處理：必須劃線並簽名縮寫+日期，或標注 N/A，不得留空
blocks.en: Handling blank fields: must be lined out and signed with initials + date, or marked N/A; they must not be left empty

blocks.zh: 文件標識：每頁至少簽名縮寫+日期一次
blocks.en: Document identification: initials + date at least once on every page

blocks.zh: 📈 N/A vs. N/AV 的區別
blocks.en: 📈 The Difference between N/A and N/AV

blocks.zh: 這個細節常被忽略但很重要：
blocks.en: This detail is often overlooked but important:

blocks.zh: N/A（Not Applicable，不適用）：只能在文件核准執行之前標注，表示這個測試項目根本不適用於該系統。一旦文件已核准開始執行，事後再標 N/A 通常需要解釋說明。
blocks.en: N/A (Not Applicable): may be entered only before the document is approved for execution, indicating that the test item is simply not applicable to the system. Once the document has been approved and execution has begun, marking N/A afterwards usually requires an explanation.

blocks.zh: N/AV（Not Available，無法取得）：表示在執行時該項目無法評估，通常需要偏差記錄和說明。
blocks.en: N/AV (Not Available): indicates that the item could not be assessed at the time of execution, and usually requires a deviation record and explanation.

blocks.zh: 🏭 CDMO GDocP 訓練重點
blocks.en: 🏭 CDMO GDocP Training Priorities

blocks.zh: CDMO 在操作員 GDocP 培訓中最應強調的行為準則：
blocks.en: The behavioral rules a CDMO should emphasize most in operator GDocP training:

blocks.zh: 「執行即記錄」文化——不接受「先做後記」
blocks.en: A culture of "record as you execute"; "do first, record later" is not accepted

blocks.zh: 記錄實際觀察值，不得記錄「意見」（Pass/OK）
blocks.en: Record the actual observed values, not "opinions" (Pass/OK)

blocks.zh: 空白必須處理（N/A + 縮寫 + 日期）
blocks.en: Blanks must be dealt with (N/A + initials + date)

blocks.zh: 任何修改要可追溯（見13.5節）
blocks.en: Any change must be traceable (see Section 13.5)

blocks.zh: 不得使用修正液（Whiteout）
blocks.en: Correction fluid (whiteout) must not be used

blocks.zh: 13.4 Attachments and Supporting Documentation — 附件與佐證文件
blocks.en: 13.4 Attachments and Supporting Documentation

blocks.zh: 📎 附件標識的完整要求
blocks.en: 📎 Complete Requirements for Attachment Identification

blocks.zh: 每份附件（printout、報告、截圖）必須標注7個資訊才算合規：
blocks.en: Each attachment (printout, report, screenshot) must carry 7 pieces of information to be compliant:

blocks.zh: 方案/協議號（Protocol No.）
blocks.en: Protocol No.

blocks.zh: 唯一附件編號（Attachment No.）
blocks.en: Unique Attachment No.

blocks.zh: 測試腳本 ID
blocks.en: Test script ID

blocks.zh: 步驟編號
blocks.en: Step number

blocks.zh: 測試員縮寫
blocks.en: Tester's initials

blocks.zh: 日期
blocks.en: Date

blocks.zh: 頁碼格式：第 X 頁，共 Y 頁
blocks.en: Page number format: page X of Y

blocks.zh: 「第X頁，共Y頁」的設計確保任何頁面的缺失都能立即被發現。
blocks.en: The "page X of Y" design ensures that any missing page is immediately noticed.

blocks.zh: 📌 便利貼的禁令
blocks.en: 📌 The Ban on Sticky Notes

blocks.zh: 便利貼（sticky notes / Post-it）絕對禁止用於記錄原始數據，原因：
blocks.en: Sticky notes (Post-it) are strictly prohibited for recording original data, because:

blocks.zh: 容易脫落遺失，導致數據無法追溯
blocks.en: They easily fall off and get lost, making the data untraceable

blocks.zh: 無法確保「Enduring（永久性）」
blocks.en: They cannot ensure that the record is "Enduring"

blocks.zh: 無編號頁碼，無法確認完整性
blocks.en: They have no page numbers, so completeness cannot be confirmed

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠中，在批次記錄或確認文件中發現便利貼記錄，是典型的 GDocP 觀察缺失。
blocks.en: Finding sticky note records in batch records or qualification documents during an FDA inspection is a typical GDocP observation.

blocks.zh: 📅 數據日期 vs. 打印日期
blocks.en: 📅 Data Date vs. Print Date

blocks.zh: 一個常見疑問：「儀器打印日期可以晚於測試執行日期嗎？」
blocks.en: A common question: "Can the instrument print date be later than the test execution date?"

blocks.zh: 答案：可以。ISPE 明確允許打印日期晚於數據日期（例如測試是週三做的，週四才打印出來）。
blocks.en: Answer: Yes. ISPE explicitly allows the print date to be later than the data date (for example, the test was done on Wednesday and printed on Thursday).

blocks.zh: 重要的是：打印件上的數據日期必須與測試步驟執行時間一致——這才是當時記錄的體現。
blocks.en: What matters is that the data date on the printout must be consistent with the time the test step was executed; this is what demonstrates contemporaneous recording.

blocks.zh: 13.5 Corrections — 文件更正規範
blocks.en: 13.5 Corrections

blocks.zh: ✊ GDocP 更正的黃金法則 — 單線劃除
blocks.en: ✊ The Golden Rule of GDocP Corrections: Single-Line Strike-Through

blocks.zh: 這是 GDocP 中最基本也最常被違反的規定：
blocks.en: This is the most basic and most frequently violated rule in GDocP:

blocks.zh: 23.5 24.2 [縮寫] [日期]
blocks.en: 23.5 24.2 [initials] [date]

blocks.zh: 正確步驟：
blocks.en: Correct steps:

blocks.zh: 用單一橫線劃過錯誤內容（原始數據仍可辨識）
blocks.en: Draw a single horizontal line through the error (the original data must remain legible)

blocks.zh: 在旁邊寫上正確值
blocks.en: Write the correct value next to it

blocks.zh: 簽上縮寫（Initials）和更正日期
blocks.en: Add your initials and the date of correction

blocks.zh: 若原因不明顯，加上唯一參照碼並在同頁附上說明
blocks.en: If the reason is not obvious, add a unique reference code and attach an explanation on the same page

blocks.zh: 絕對禁止：修正液（Whiteout）、修正帶、覆蓋書寫、橡皮擦
blocks.en: Strictly prohibited: correction fluid (whiteout), correction tape, overwriting, erasers

blocks.zh: 🤔 為什麼原始數據必須可見？
blocks.en: 🤔 Why Must the Original Data Remain Visible?

blocks.zh: 「原始數據仍可辨識」這個要求背後是法規邏輯：
blocks.en: The requirement that "the original data remain legible" rests on regulatory logic:

blocks.zh: 若看不到原始數據，無法判斷更正是否合理
blocks.en: If the original data cannot be seen, it is impossible to judge whether the correction is justified

blocks.zh: 若錯誤被完全遮蓋，看起來像資料造假
blocks.en: If the error is completely obscured, it looks like data falsification

blocks.zh: 稽核員需要能追蹤「原始紀錄 → 更正原因 → 最終值」的完整鏈條
blocks.en: Auditors need to be able to trace the complete chain of "original record → reason for correction → final value"

blocks.zh: 使用修正液讓原始數據不可見，即使更正值是正確的，也可能被認定為違反數據完整性。
blocks.en: Using correction fluid makes the original data invisible; even if the corrected value is right, it may be judged a data integrity violation.

blocks.zh: 🏭 CDMO 實際情境：他人代為更正
blocks.en: 🏭 CDMO Real-World Scenario: Correction by Another Person

blocks.zh: 當原始記錄者已離職或無法聯繫時，需要他人代為更正，必須：
blocks.en: When the original recorder has left the company or cannot be reached and someone else must make the correction, the following is required:

blocks.zh: 確認此情況符合公司/場地 SOP 的規定
blocks.en: Confirm that this situation is permitted by the company/site SOP

blocks.zh: 更正者必須說明為何由本人代為更正
blocks.en: The person making the correction must explain why they are correcting on the original recorder's behalf

blocks.zh: 記錄更正者的縮寫和日期（而非原始記錄者）
blocks.en: Record the corrector's initials and date (not the original recorder's)

blocks.zh: 通常需要額外的說明文件或偏差記錄支持
blocks.en: Supporting documentation or a deviation record is usually required

blocks.zh: 這種情況在長期 C&Q 專案中並不少見，特別是使用臨時工程人員或承包商的情況下。
blocks.en: This situation is not uncommon in long-running C&Q projects, especially when temporary engineering staff or contractors are used.

blocks.zh: 📝 練習思考：以下哪些更正方式合規？
blocks.en: 📝 Exercise: Which of the Following Correction Methods Are Compliant?

blocks.zh: 用白色修正液蓋住錯誤，然後在上面寫正確值 → 不合規（原始數據無法辨識）
blocks.en: Cover the error with white correction fluid and write the correct value over it → Non-compliant (original data cannot be read)

blocks.zh: 用雙線劃過錯誤的完整數字，旁邊寫正確值並簽名縮寫和日期 → 合規
blocks.en: Strike through the complete incorrect number with a line, write the correct value beside it, and add initials and date → Compliant

blocks.zh: 只劃掉錯誤數字中的一個位數，保留其他位數 → 不合規（應劃掉完整數值）
blocks.en: Strike through only one digit of the incorrect number and keep the other digits → Non-compliant (the complete value should be struck through)

blocks.zh: 劃掉錯誤值後添加更正值，但沒有日期 → 不合規（缺少日期，違反 Attributable）
blocks.en: Strike out the incorrect value and add the corrected value, but with no date → Non-compliant (missing date, violating Attributable)

blocks.zh: 原因不明顯的更正，添加腳注說明更正理由 → 合規
blocks.en: For a correction whose reason is not obvious, add a footnote explaining the reason → Compliant

blocks.zh: 13.6 Document Review and Approval — 文件審核與核准
blocks.en: 13.6 Document Review and Approval

blocks.zh: ✅ 審核者/核准者的職責
blocks.en: ✅ Responsibilities of Reviewers/Approvers

blocks.zh: 批准文件不只是「蓋章」，審核者必須確認四大事項：
blocks.en: Approving a document is not just "stamping"; the reviewer must confirm four things:

blocks.zh: 完整性：所有附件、記錄表都已正確填寫
blocks.en: Completeness: all attachments and record forms have been filled in correctly

blocks.zh: 可讀性：文件清晰易讀，沒有模糊不清的部分
blocks.en: Legibility: the document is clear and easy to read, with no unclear parts

blocks.zh: 合格性：所有測試結果均符合預先設定的接受標準
blocks.en: Acceptability: all test results meet the predefined acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: 偏差已關閉：所有偏差記錄均已經過調查、採取行動並獲核准關閉
blocks.en: Deviations closed: all deviation records have been investigated, actioned and approved for closure

blocks.zh: ⚠ 偏差未關閉即核准文件的後果
blocks.en: ⚠ Consequences of Approving a Document with Unclosed Deviations

blocks.zh: 若核准者在未完全解決所有偏差的情況下核准文件，可能導致：
blocks.en: If an approver approves a document without fully resolving all deviations, this may result in:

blocks.zh: 確認包（Validation Package）被認定為不完整
blocks.en: The qualification package (Validation Package) being deemed incomplete

blocks.zh: 法規查廠時被列為重大觀察項目
blocks.en: It being cited as a major observation in a regulatory inspection

blocks.zh: 需要重新執行確認活動
blocks.en: Qualification activities having to be re-executed

blocks.zh: 產品上市延遲
blocks.en: Delays in product launch

blocks.zh: 核准者的簽名代表對整份文件品質的背書——這是重大責任。
blocks.en: The approver's signature represents an endorsement of the quality of the entire document; this is a significant responsibility.

blocks.zh: 🏭 CDMO 試車文件的 QA 審核範圍
blocks.en: 🏭 Scope of QA Review of CDMO Commissioning Documents

blocks.zh: ISPE 允許QA對試車文件的審核範圍限縮到「與產品影響相關的測試」，即：
blocks.en: ISPE allows QA review of commissioning documents to be limited to "tests relevant to product impact", that is:

blocks.zh: 涉及 CDE 的測試項目 → QA 必須審核
blocks.en: Test items involving CDEs → QA must review

blocks.zh: 純工程性能測試（如管道承壓、電氣接地）→ QA 可選擇性審核
blocks.en: Purely engineering performance tests (e.g., pipe pressure rating, electrical grounding) → QA review is optional

blocks.zh: 這個彈性設計讓 CDMO 的 QA 部門可以將稽核資源集中在真正有品質影響的項目上，提高效率。
blocks.en: This flexible design lets a CDMO's QA department focus its audit resources on the items that truly affect quality, improving efficiency.

blocks.zh: 13.7–13.8 Storage, Retrieval, Retention & Disaster Recovery — 文件儲存與災難復原
blocks.en: 13.7–13.8 Storage, Retrieval, Retention & Disaster Recovery

blocks.zh: 📂 文件儲存的三大要求
blocks.en: 📂 Three Requirements for Document Storage

blocks.zh: 可及時取得：法規要求能在合理時間內找到並提供文件——查廠時通常是「立即」或「數小時內」
blocks.en: Timely retrieval: regulations require that documents can be found and provided within a reasonable time; in an inspection this usually means "immediately" or "within a few hours"

blocks.zh: 存取控制：文件室（或電子系統）必須有存取管理，防止未授權存取或修改
blocks.en: Access control: the document room (or electronic system) must have access management to prevent unauthorized access or modification

blocks.zh: 安全存放：防潮、防火、防損毀的儲存環境
blocks.en: Secure storage: a storage environment protected against moisture, fire and damage

blocks.zh: ⚠ 電子化歸檔的法規要求
blocks.en: ⚠ Regulatory Requirements for Electronic Archiving

blocks.zh: 將紙本文件掃描後以電子檔歸檔是允許的，但必須滿足：
blocks.en: Scanning paper documents and archiving them electronically is permitted, but the following must be met:

blocks.zh: 電子文件管理系統（EDMS）必須是已確認的（validated）系統
blocks.en: The electronic document management system (EDMS) must be a validated system

blocks.zh: 掃描後可以銷毀紙本，但需有書面程序規範此流程
blocks.en: Paper originals may be destroyed after scanning, but a written procedure must govern the process

blocks.zh: 適用法規的特定保存期限必須查明並遵守（各國法規不同）
blocks.en: The specific retention periods under the applicable regulations must be identified and followed (they differ by country)

blocks.zh: 美國 FDA：GMP 記錄通常需保存至少2年（藥品有效期後），或更長
blocks.en: US FDA: GMP records generally must be retained for at least 2 years (after the expiry date of the drug product), or longer

blocks.zh: 歐盟 EMA / PICS：類似要求，但具體依產品類型而定
blocks.en: EU EMA / PIC/S: similar requirements, but specifics depend on product type

blocks.zh: 📦 21 CFR Part 11 與電子記錄
blocks.en: 📦 21 CFR Part 11 and Electronic Records

blocks.zh: 若使用電子系統儲存和管理確認文件，美國法規 21 CFR Part 11（電子記錄與電子簽名）即適用，要求：
blocks.en: If an electronic system is used to store and manage qualification documents, the US regulation 21 CFR Part 11 (electronic records and electronic signatures) applies and requires:

blocks.zh: 稽核追蹤（Audit Trail）：自動記錄誰在何時建立、修改、刪除記錄
blocks.en: Audit trail: automatically records who created, modified or deleted a record, and when

blocks.zh: 電子簽名：必須與簽署人唯一連結，不可否認（non-repudiation）
blocks.en: Electronic signatures: must be uniquely linked to the signatory and non-repudiable

blocks.zh: 系統確認：EDMS 本身需要通過 GAMP 5 等框架進行 CSV（電腦系統確認）
blocks.en: System validation: the EDMS itself must undergo CSV (computerized system validation) under a framework such as GAMP 5

blocks.zh: 數據保護：防止未授權修改，電子記錄的完整性必須受到保護
blocks.en: Data protection: prevent unauthorized modification; the integrity of electronic records must be protected

blocks.zh: 歐盟對應法規為 EU Annex 11（電腦化系統）。
blocks.en: The EU equivalent is EU Annex 11 (Computerised Systems).

blocks.zh: 🚨 災難復原程序
blocks.en: 🚨 Disaster Recovery Procedure

blocks.zh: 文件損毀（如火災、水災、電腦崩潰）時的應對程序：
blocks.en: The procedure to follow when documents are damaged (e.g., fire, flood, computer crash):

blocks.zh: 優先嘗試復原原始文件（如從備份系統、其他副本）
blocks.en: First try to recover the original documents (e.g., from a backup system or other copies)

blocks.zh: 若無法復原，可接受原始文件的副本作為正式記錄
blocks.en: If recovery is not possible, a copy of the original document may be accepted as the official record

blocks.zh: 副本必須由管理層（Management）核准，確認其為有效替代
blocks.en: The copy must be approved by Management, confirming it as a valid replacement

blocks.zh: 建立事件記錄，說明原始文件損失的原因和過程
blocks.en: Create an event record explaining the cause and circumstances of the loss of the original document

blocks.zh: 預防勝於治療——C&Q 執行期間即應規劃文件儲存策略，最小化損失風險。
blocks.en: Prevention is better than cure: a document storage strategy should be planned during C&Q execution to minimize the risk of loss.

blocks.zh: 🏭 CDMO 文件保存的實務建議
blocks.en: 🏭 Practical Recommendations for CDMO Document Retention

blocks.zh: 多重備份：重要文件（如確認包）建議保有：原件 + 數位掃描件（EDMS）+ 異地備份
blocks.en: Multiple backups: for important documents (such as the qualification package), keep the original + a digital scan (EDMS) + an off-site backup

blocks.zh: 保存期限管理：建立文件銷毀排程，確保在監管保存期限結束前不得銷毀 GMP 記錄
blocks.en: Retention period management: establish a document destruction schedule to ensure GMP records are not destroyed before the regulatory retention period ends

blocks.zh: 客戶交付物管理：CDMO 為客戶執行的確認工作，文件的所有權和保存責任需在合約中明確約定
blocks.en: Management of customer deliverables: for qualification work a CDMO performs for customers, ownership of documents and responsibility for retention must be clearly agreed in the contract

blocks.zh: 查廠準備：確保查廠時能在30分鐘內提供任意指定的歷史確認文件——這是衡量文件管理體系效率的實際指標
blocks.en: Inspection readiness: ensure that any specified historical qualification document can be provided within 30 minutes during an inspection; this is a practical measure of the efficiency of the documentation system

blocks.zh: 📋 本節重點摘要 Section Summary
blocks.en: 📋 Section Summary

blocks.zh: Chapter 12：變更管理兩大支柱
blocks.en: Chapter 12: The Two Pillars of Change Management

blocks.zh: ECM（工程變更管理）適用於系統放行前的C&Q及建造期間，由工程/運營主導，CDE相關變更須QA核准但不需預先批准；非關鍵面向在放行後亦可繼續使用ECM。
blocks.en: ECM (Engineering Change Management) applies to C&Q and construction before system release, led by Engineering/Operations; CDE-related changes require QA approval but not prior approval; non-critical aspects may continue to use ECM after release.

blocks.zh: QCC（品質變更管制）適用於系統放行後的所有CDE/CA相關變更，由QA主導，所有變更必須在實施前取得QA預先核准；法規依據為21 CFR 211.100及EU GMP §5.23。
blocks.en: QCC (Quality Change Control) applies to all CDE/CA-related changes after system release, led by QA; all changes must obtain QA prior approval before implementation; the regulatory basis is 21 CFR 211.100 and EU GMP §5.23.

blocks.zh: 偏差修正優先順序：設計變更 > 安裝變更 > 程序變更，依賴SOP彌補硬體缺陷是最後手段。
blocks.en: Order of priority for deviation correction: design change > installation change > procedure change; relying on an SOP to compensate for hardware defects is the last resort.

blocks.zh: Chapter 13：GDocP 六大核心原則
blocks.en: Chapter 13: The Six Core Principles of GDocP

blocks.zh: ALCOA+（可歸責、清晰易讀、當時記錄、原始資料、準確 + 完整、一致、永久性、可取得）是文件管理的基石，直接對應 FDA 數據完整性要求。
blocks.en: ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate + Complete, Consistent, Enduring, Available) is the cornerstone of documentation management and maps directly to FDA data integrity requirements.

blocks.zh: 當時記錄（Contemporaneous）是最常被違反的原則之一；事後補記（backdating）是FDA 483最常引用的缺失。
blocks.en: Contemporaneous recording is one of the most frequently violated principles; backdating is the deficiency most often cited in FDA 483s.

blocks.zh: 更正規範：單線劃除（原始數據仍可辨識）+ 正確值 + 縮寫 + 日期；絕對禁止修正液、塗改、覆蓋書寫。
blocks.en: Correction rules: single-line strike-through (original data remains legible) + correct value + initials + date; correction fluid, obliteration and overwriting are strictly prohibited.

blocks.zh: 試車文件（GEP）可用於支持確認（GMP），前提是達到GMP文件標準（事先確認廠商文件品質）。
blocks.en: Commissioning documents (GEP) can be used to support qualification (GMP), provided they meet GMP documentation standards (assess the quality of vendor documents in advance).

blocks.zh: 電子記錄須符合21 CFR Part 11（美國）或EU Annex 11（歐盟），確認EDMS系統並維護稽核追蹤。
blocks.en: Electronic records must comply with 21 CFR Part 11 (US) or EU Annex 11 (EU); validate the EDMS and maintain audit trails.

blocks.zh: 文件儲存需確保隨時可取得；C&Q期間即應建立防損失計畫，並在災難發生時有復原程序。
blocks.en: Document storage must ensure availability at all times; a loss-prevention plan should be established during C&Q, with a recovery procedure in place for when disaster strikes.
